description: Classic CRT terminal aesthetic — near-black background, phosphor green text, cyan accents, monospace throughout.

Intro.bio: This is an example of a “terminal” type of theme for my portfolio. All features within each theme are driven by a JSON file, this paragraph among them. I built this portfolio to demonstrate my expertise in multi-tenant platform configuration and accessible design, as I am very interested in full-stack engineering opportunities that extend deep front-end architecture into end-to-end product work.
